lang.jei.silentgear.blueprint.desc: Blueprints and templates are used to craft tool heads and armor. Blueprints can be reused infinitely, templates are single-use. When used in the crafting station, you can mix materials. Otherwise, the materials must all be the same. Check the tooltip of the blueprint/template for details on crafting the final item.
lang.jei.silentgear.dagger.desc: Basically a very light sword. Low damage and shorter reach, but very high attack speed. It also reduces the target's invulnerability time when hit.
lang.jei.silentgear.fishing_rod.desc: It's a fishing rod. What more do you want?
lang.jei.silentgear.hammer.desc: Mines stone and ores in a 3x3 area. Ores are only broken when aiming at ores, by default.
lang.jei.silentgear.katana.desc: A sword that is heavier and stronger than standard swords.
lang.jei.silentgear.knife.desc: Similar to daggers. Has higher durability, but less damage and speed.
lang.jei.silentgear.machete.desc: A multi-function blade. It's a sword, axe, and sickle, but works best as a sword. Slightly faster and weaker than standard swords. Like sickles, it can clear an area of plants, but the range is smaller.
lang.jei.silentgear.mattock.desc: The ultimate farming tool, capable of tilling and digging soil and chopping wood. A bit slower than a shovel or axe, but more durable. Should work in anything that requires a hoe.
lang.jei.silentgear.paxel.desc: An all-in-one tool that functions as a pickaxe, axe, and shovel. It has a small durability bonus, but a small penalty to harvest speed and enchantability.
lang.jei.silentgear.prospector_hammer.desc: Right-clicking a block will search a small area in that direction for blocks of interest (mostly ores). Also works like a pickaxe for mining, and can be used in some recipes like a hammer.
lang.jei.silentgear.red_card_upgrade.desc: Tools and armor with the red card upgrade can break like their vanilla counterparts, instead of becoming a "broken" item that can still be repaired.
lang.jei.silentgear.saw.desc: Chops down entire trees by breaking a single block. The logs and leaves must be correctly tagged to be recognized as a tree.
lang.jei.silentgear.sickle.desc: Breaks plants in a small area by breaking one. Can harvest crops in a small area by right-clicking, automatically replanting them, but destroying the seeds in the process.
lang.jei.silentgear.slingshot.desc: Fast draw speed, low damage. Can only fire pebbles right now, but will support custom bullets soon.
lang.jei.silentgear.spear.desc: Weaker than swords, but has a longer attack reach.
lang.jei.silentgear.spoon_upgrade.desc: Let's your pickaxe mine dirt and such. Because reasons.
lang.jei.silentgear.sword.desc: A classic sword with balanced damage and speed. The guard takes the appearance of the second material used in crafting.
lang.jei.silentgear.tip_upgrade.desc: Allows an existing tool/weapon to be further upgraded. Most tip upgrades will add (or subtract) a fixed amount to certain stats, but some add will multipliers instead. Hold the Ctrl key to view stat modifiers in the tooltip.
lang.jei.silentgear.tool_head.desc: Tool heads, blades, bow limbs, and more! These are the core of tools and weapons, constructed with a blueprint/template and some number of main tool materials. Check the blueprint/template tooltip for more info.
lang.jei.silentgear.tooltip.sample2: Gear made with any materials will work
lang.material.silentgear.azure_electrum.book_: An alloy made using azure silver. While lacking in durability, it excels in speed. It can be crafted at a crafting table, but the Alloy Forge is more efficient.
lang.material.silentgear.azure_silver.book_de: Azure silver can be mined in The End. It is used to create azure electrum.
lang.material.silentgear.barrier.book_desc: A gag material that is not normally obtainable.
lang.material.silentgear.blaze_gold.book_desc: Made with gold and blaze powder. Although it can be crafted in a crafting table, the Alloy Forge is more efficient.
lang.material.silentgear.crimson_iron.book_de: Crimson iron can be mined in the Nether. It is used to create crimson steel.
lang.material.silentgear.crimson_steel.book_d: An alloy made using crimson iron. It is all-around strong and fire-resistant. It can be crafted at a crafting table, but the Alloy Forge is more efficient.
lang.material.silentgear.crude_alloy.book_des: A compound material created in the Crude Mixer. While the resulting mixed material is weakened by the "Crude" modifier, the Crude Mixer is easy to obtain and can mix any material, regardless of category.
lang.material.silentgear.dimerald.book_desc: A gem formed by combining diamond and emerald. This material serves as an example custom compound material.
lang.material.silentgear.example.book_desc: This material is used as a placeholder in some cases for technical reasons. It is not obtainable in survival.
lang.material.silentgear.high_carbon_steel.bo: This material serves as an example custom compound material.
lang.material.silentgear.hybrid_gem.book_desc: A compound material created from gems and/or dusts in the Recrystallizer. The properties of the final product depends on the materials used.
lang.material.silentgear.metal_alloy.book_des: A compound material created from metals and/or dusts in the Alloy Forge. The properties of the final product depends on the materials used.
lang.material.silentgear.mixed_fabric.book_de: A compound material created from cloths, fibers, or slimes in the Refabricator. The properties of the final product depends on the materials used.
lang.material.silentgear.netherite.book_desc: Netherite works exclusively as a coating material, to mimic vanilla mechanics as closely as possible. A netherite-coated diamond tool should be nearly identical to vanilla netherite.
lang.material.silentgear.sheet_metal.book_des: A material created in the Metal Press. It is well suited for crafting elytras. You can also make armor with sheet metal, but it is signicantly less effective.
lang.material.silentgear.super_alloy.book_des: A compound material created in the Super Mixer. Any material can be used, regardless of category. There are no penalties applied to the resulting compound, unlike the Crude Mixer.
lang.material.silentgear.tyrian_steel.book_de: The strongest basic material added by Silent Gear. It can only be crafted in the Alloy Forge.
